title: Add model-agnostic Virtual Memory R0 and redundant visual navigation

before.state: Accessible Memory, SuperIndex and Dependency Folding established bounded selective-access experiments, but the Hybrid memory unit exposed only Address/Value/Links and there was no generic fidelity ladder, context packet, CID/address separation, multi-carrier graph-signature federation or visual macro/meso/micro memory projection.

after.state: Virtual Memory R0 defines a model-agnostic addressable memory node, metadata-only search, graph-addressed selective unfolding, bounded ContextPacket, working-set cache, carrier GraphSignature federation and an experimental visual macro/meso/micro navigation band coexisting with the verified exact transport in one PNG.

compatibility.legacy_memory: Address/Value/Links carriers remain queryable as summary-level legacy nodes
compatibility.new_transport: RenderMemory/DecodeMemoryPNG add a declared redundant navigation band

invariants: active context is separate from total memory
visual navigation is redundant and never exactness authority
42 visual families remain evidence-gated generator-tree candidates

deterministic: composite PNG -> exact logical memory recovery

promotion.specialized_llm: out of scope; future optional consumer
